reasons: No insurance obligation exists anywhere in the Agreement, and Kubient is plainly a hosting/services vendor that hosts the Auction Platform and collects/stores visitor data — absence of any coverage is walk-away territory under the rule, so 'missing' is correctly classified.

The inserted paragraph tracks the playbook model language at the preferred limits (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M where Customer/visitor data is processed, workers' compensation as required by Law, certificates on request) and is placed as a new subsection (j) in the section 14 General Provisions, disturbing no other terms.
The comment is accurate, concise, in our voice, explains the change, cites the standard limits and offers the E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M fallback, consistent with the required tone.
Minor drafting note only (not a defect requiring rejection): confirm 'Term' is a defined term in the Agreement and that subsection lettering does not collide with any following subsection at p0074.
